skill.name: onboarding
skill.description: Guide first-time ElevenLabs setup for an app, from browser approval and API key configuration to SDK integration and an optional test.
skill.summary: Connect an app to ElevenLabs and verify its initial setup.
skill.author: elevenlabs

security_audit.summary: The backtick and reconnaissance alerts are false positives, but both fallback installers execute unpinned remote scripts. The default npm launch also runs an unpinned package, and the skill directs agents to trust commands and approval messages from CLI output. No evidence of credential theft or actual malicious payloads was found in the reviewed file.

remediation.issue: Fallback installers execute remote scripts directly.
remediation.suggestion: Remove both inline installers. Use a pinned, signed release and verify it before installation. Keep normal PowerShell execution policy in place.

remediation.issue: CLI output can direct arbitrary actions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat CLI output as data. Map validated step names to reviewed commands with fixed executable paths and arguments. Require approval for new side effects.

remediation.issue: User messages and approval links are relayed without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and validate approval links against approved ElevenLabs hosts. Build user messages from reviewed templates rather than relaying CLI text verbatim.

remediation.issue: The default npm launch runs a mutable package version without a package prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited CLI version and verify package integrity. Ask before installing it, and prefer a verified local binary.

content.user_title: Set Up ElevenLabs in Your App
content.value_statement: First-time ElevenLabs setup requires account approval, credential configuration, and SDK setup. This skill guides those steps in your app and asks before running a test.
actual_capabilities: Guide browser approval and API key setup with the ElevenLabs CLI.
Ask which product to integrate or whether to add only the SDK.
Add an SDK integration or configure credential loading for code that already uses the SDK.
Create a required ElevenLabs resource, such as a voice agent, when the requested integration needs one.
Run the CLI setup check and ask for approval before making a live test request.
limitations: Requires internet access and either Node.js for npm tooling or a compatible ElevenLabs CLI.
If browser approval cannot reach the machine, the user must configure the key locally.
Does not cover rotating a broken key or installing one issued by an administrator.
The documented installers are unpinned, and the workflow does not validate CLI commands or approval links before using them.

use_cases.title: Add the SDK to a New App
use_cases.description: Set up the project for ElevenLabs without choosing or implementing a voice feature yet.

use_cases.title: Prototype Text to Speech
use_cases.description: Plan a small speech integration and decide whether to approve a live test after reviewing the setup.

use_cases.title: Connect an Existing SDK
use_cases.description: Configure the key for an app that already uses the SDK, without changing unrelated code.

prompt_templates.title: Plan First-Time Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to connect my app to ElevenLabs and where I will need browser approval. Do not install anything or run a test.

prompt_templates.title: Scope an SDK-Only Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: The app needs the SDK but no voice feature yet.
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify where the ElevenLabs SDK and its key configuration belong in this app. Show the proposed changes and wait for my approval.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Speech Test
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: The app needs a small text to speech integration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Propose a minimal text to speech integration using the existing project conventions. Use sample text and ask before any network request or code change.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Headless Voice Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: The app runs remotely and already uses the SDK.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review credential loading for the voice agent app in this monorepo. Explain how I can configure the key locally. Do not read secrets or create resources.

output_examples.input: I want the SDK only. What decisions do I need to make?
output: Choose the app that will own the SDK dependency and load the credential.
Approve account access in your browser when prompted. Keep the key out of chat and source code.
After setup, review the verification result before deciding whether to run a live test.

output_examples.input: My remote app already uses the SDK, but browser approval cannot reach it.
output: Configure the key in the remote app's local secret configuration without sharing it in chat.
Check that the existing SDK integration can load the credential without printing it.
No live test is needed unless you approve one.

best_practices: Use a verified, pinned CLI release and review proposed commands before authorizing execution.
Keep the API key in local secret configuration and confirm the approval page belongs to ElevenLabs.
Confirm the target app and approve any resource creation or live test separately.
anti_patterns: Running unreviewed commands emitted by the CLI or executing an installer directly from a download.
Pasting a key into chat, logging it, or committing it to source control.
Treating browser approval as consent to create remote resources or send test data.

faq.question: Can I add only the SDK?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks whether you want the SDK alone or a specific integration.

faq.question: Do I need Node.js?
faq.answer: The default launch requires Node.js. A verified local ElevenLabs CLI can be used instead.

faq.question: What happens if browser approval cannot reach my machine?
faq.answer: Configure the key locally on that machine and continue setup. Do not send the key in chat.

faq.question: Will setup run a live test automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill calls for a setup check and asks for consent before a live test.

faq.question: Does this replace a broken API key?
faq.answer: No. This skill is for first-time setup, not key rotation or configuration of an administrator-issued key.

faq.question: Should I run the documented fallback installers?
faq.answer: Avoid executing downloaded scripts directly. Prefer a pinned CLI release from a trusted source and verify it before running it.
